events.headline: Global equities slide as recession fears mount; Nasdaq down 3.9%
events.summary: A broad risk-off session driven by macro data. Selling is indiscriminate across sectors rather than concentrated in individual companies.

events.headline: Megacap tech and semiconductors lead the selloff, sector down 4.6%
events.summary: The move is sector-wide and tracks the macro session. No individual company reported bad news today.

events.headline: Fed holds rates steady, signals fewer cuts than markets expected
events.summary: Higher-for-longer rates weigh most on long-duration growth names; defensives are relatively insulated.

events.headline: Johnson & Johnson beats Q2 estimates and raises full-year guidance
events.summary: Company-specific positive news: pharma segment revenue ahead of consensus, guidance lifted.

events.headline: Netflix subscriber growth stalls, shares fall 7.9%
events.summary: Company-specific miss. Relevant only to holders of NFLX.

events.headline: Crude slips 1.5% on a larger-than-expected inventory build
events.summary: Modest pressure on integrated energy names; well within normal weekly range.

events.headline: Quantum computing name QBITX up 180% this month as retail piles in
events.summary: Momentum-driven move with heavy retail flow and social media attention. No revenue and no earnings history. Frequently cited in 'everyone is buying this' conversations.

events.headline: Eurozone composite PMI misses expectations
events.summary: Regional macro datapoint with negligible read-through to a US-listed portfolio of this composition.

events.headline: EU opens antitrust probe into app store commission structure
events.summary: Company-specific regulatory risk. Potentially material to the affected company's services revenue over time; not a same-day price event.

events.headline: Bitcoin drops 6% in overnight trading
events.summary: Different asset class. No holdings exposure.

events.headline: Defensive rotation lifts pharma and staples
events.summary: Money rotating out of growth and into defensives — the other side of the tech selloff.

events.headline: Broker trims price target on Microsoft, keeps rating unchanged
events.summary: A single analyst's target adjustment. Low informational value on its own.

events.headline: NIFTY reverses sharply intraday, weekly 24850 Call premium collapses into expiry week
events.summary: The underlying index gave back the session's gains in the final hour. With only a few trading days left before this contract's weekly expiry, time decay is accelerating on top of the adverse move — a combination that makes expiry-week options risk different in kind from the same percentage move in a stock.
